data.title: Electronics & Semiconductor Assembly Robotics Market to Reach USD 17.1 Billion by 2036 as Smart Factory Automation and Semiconductor Manufacturing Expansion Drive Global Growth
data.description: According to Future Market Insights (FMI), the global Electronics & Semiconductor Assembly Robotics Market is expected to experience strong growth as semiconductor manufacturers and electronics producers accelerate investments in factory automation, precision assembly, and smart manufacturing technologies. the market is projected to grow from USD 6.6 billion in 2026 to USD 17.1 billion by 2036, registering a robust 10.0% CAGR during the forecast period.
